description: Policy is set here rather than inherited. github>unional/renovate-preset resolves to
config:base + :preserveSemverRanges and nothing else - no automerge, no soak - so
extending it looked like policy while providing none.
rebaseWhen is 'auto', not 'behind-base-branch'. This repo has a merge queue, so
strict_required_status_checks_policy is off and a PR does not need to be up to date to
enqueue - the queue rebuilds each candidate against the real base. Forcing a rebase of
every open PR each time main moves would re-run the full matrix for nothing.

packageRules.description: Majors break builds in ways CI catches but a human should choose to absorb.
